section.title: Annual leave
section.rule: Staff with less than 1 year of service earn 1.5 working days of leave for each month worked.
Staff with 1 to 3 years of service get 18 working days of annual leave per year.
Staff with more than 3 years of service get 21 working days of annual leave per year.
Up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next year. They must be used before 31 March or they are lost.

section.title: Requesting leave
section.rule: Leave of more than 5 working days must be requested at least 14 days in advance.
Leave of 5 working days or less needs at least 3 days of notice. The branch manager approves it.

section.title: Sick and family leave
section.rule: Sick leave is paid for up to 7 days a year. A doctor's certificate is needed from the third day.
New fathers get 4 days of paid paternity leave, taken within 30 days of the birth.
